point release of alpha 8, all about steam. it is still experimental. mihawkos offers this update by itself from 7.1 and alpha 8 what s new: steam s browser runs inside mihawkos : big picture s pages use far less of the console what s new: your game comes first : steam steps aside when you press play, and comes back when you quit what s new: cloud saves you can trust : steam finishes its steam cloud upload before it closes what s new: new handover screens : getting your game ready and welcome back , on the game s own artwork steam s browser runs inside mihawkos big picture s store, library and sign-in pages are drawn by steam s built-in browser. in alpha 8 it ran as a separate program beside mihawkos; now it runs inside it far lighter on the console: about 710 of the console s page tables in ten minutes of browsing, against about 1,870 before base ps5, firmware 13.60 pages scroll at about 120 fps your game comes first when you press play on a game in big picture, steam now steps aside so the game gets all the room on the console 1. mihawkos shows getting ready and asks steam to close. steam saves its session and closes by itself 2. the game starts with steam running quietly behind it, and nothing else 3. when you quit the game, mihawkos shows welcome back , steam saves to steam cloud and closes, and big picture opens again where you left it measured on a base ps5 with the resident evil 3: raccoon city demo: about 6,200 page tables free during play, against about 5,300 in alpha 8, at 110 to 120 fps this handover is for 64-bit games . a 32-bit game started from big picture runs as it did in alpha 8: beside steam with no handover screens, and steam syncs its cloud saves as usual when it ends. 32-bit games join the handover in a later update the failed to start process for this game: general failure 0x1f pop-up that could flash when you pressed play is gone. if steam ever stops responding during a handover, mihawkos asks whether to keep waiting or close steam cloud saves you can trust when a game ends, mihawkos now waits until steam has seen it end. steam does its steam cloud upload first, and only then is it asked to close. on the console, steam s own log shows the upload completing two seconds before steam closed new handover screens getting ready and welcome back , each with a short checklist that ticks off what has really happened steam saving its session, room being made for the game, the game starting, the cloud save, big picture reopening drawn in frosted glass over the game s own steam artwork , read from steam s library on the console. games without artwork get the aero sky in all 10 languages the screen stays up until the game s first frames take over, in one step, without flicker also fixed settings shows release names. the update check reads alpha 8.1 and alpha 8 instead of a raw number such as 01.003.000 , which could appear cut off as 1 every windows setup gets the new built-in files when mihawkos updates. until now, a setup made by an older release could keep a few of its old windows modules after an update; it now refreshes all of them known issues a brief black frame when mihawkos switches between big picture and the game. it is next on the list big picture can still hitch now and then while pages load. smoothing it out comes after 8.1 not fixed yet on the controller: camera drift, the create button, the touchpad as a mouse, the steam input cursor and input lag. some games, such as the binding of isaac, can map the controller oddly; this is being looked at restart the ps5 now and then. pipe memory runs out after very many program starts; mihawkos says restart the ps5 when that happens the per-boot setup is yours: your payloads after every cold boot. never use rest mode with payloads loaded not supported: drm such as denuvo, and anti-cheat such as easy anti-cheat or battleye everything else from alpha 8 still applies installing or updating ps5 mihawkos-v8.1.0-alpha-8.zip size: 434215489.body: fully packed games this version runs games packed with every file in zstd or lz4 packs, no more need to select which files to pack or not except for crucial ones - like eboot.bin that saves more space and removes the need for custom toml configs new virtual-fd reads run on runtime threads with their own stacks, so a game thread with a small stack no longer crashes on a packed read pool 88 - 128 mib, decoded cache on by default 16 mib . more speed for games and better stability stability fixes for shutdown, mmap of packed files, page cache errors and pack fd accounting debug build black box trace in data ampr emu trace.txt : loaded modules with segment addresses and every failed file event, written as the game runs for crashes that happen before :9090 answers fsfail also logs packed files that reach an api the runtime does not serve thanks to everyone who tested, packed and played games with zstd packs so far - your feedback made this release better how to use copy libsceampr.sprx into the game s fakelib and mount the game with shadowmountplus disable fakelib update in settings zstd and lz4 packs can be made by ps5-dump-forge

435597949.body: fixed days gone remastered 9 hung on the loading screen and sonic x shadow generations 8 crashed at launch. in both, the ps5 would not report whether a memory address was writable, and the runtime then refused the game s write to it. that write now goes through reporting a game issues now have a game report form. please share how your games run, both the ones that fail and the ones that work how to use copy libsceampr.sprx into the game s fakelib and mount the game with shadowmountplus disable fakelib update in settings zstd and lz4 packs can be made by ps5-dump-forge
bullets: days gone remastered 9 hung on the loading screen and sonic x shadow

436303212.body: fixed resonance: a plague tale legacy ppsa30601, 14 now plays as a fully packed install. it used to stay on a black screen because it opens one packed file over and over until the runtime ran out of slots for packed files. packed files now get ordinary low file numbers, like loose files open packed files no longer count against the runtime s own open-file limit, so many open packed files can t hold up pack reads thanks jamesst20 for their first contribution 16 , both plague tale fixes found and tested on their own console everyone who reported a game since v0.3.1: ozankabulut 12 luminusalk 13 , rgdevz 15 and akaguiri 17 reporting a game issues have a game report form. please share how your games run, both the ones that fail and the ones that work how to use copy libsceampr.sprx into the game s fakelib and mount the game with shadowmountplus disable fakelib update in settings zstd and lz4 packs can be made by ps5-dump-forge

434932786.body: new ampr-emu-ng v0.3.0. the bundled runtime is the v0.3.0 release, which serves fully packed zstd and lz4 games pack any game. pack now works on games whose eboot.bin doesn t import libsceampr . it installs ampr-emu-ng at fakelib libsceampr.sprx , which shadowmount loads pack everything. zstd pack, and lz4 pack with ampr-emu-ng, now pack everything except system files eboot.bin , executables and modules, sce sys , sce module , fakelib , the runtime s own files , so audio, video and configs get packed too picker shortcuts. add shortcut pins the folder shown, on any device, up to 9 in all. every picker lists them as chips above the files; click one to open that folder fixes zstd pack reads and compresses each file once. the rule that stored a whole file uncompressed when it saved under 1 is gone; only the chunks zstd can t shrink are stored raw, so large, barely compressible files no longer cost a second read archives and fpkg files on another device used to be missing from the picker. they are now listed greyed out, with a note that they open from this device only thanks libraaaaa2792 reported 18, which brought the picker shortcuts dexil123 reported 20, which made archives on another device show in the picker caimiao reported 15, which helped to push forward packing strategy and testing zstd format
bullets: ampr-emu-ng v0.3.0. the bundled runtime is the v0.3.0 release, which serves fully packed zstd and lz4 games

picker shortcuts. add shortcut pins the folder shown, on any device, up to 9 in all. every picker lists them as chips above the files; click one to open that folder
